title: lathyrus maritimus subsp. pubescens
intro: Lathyrus maritimus subsp. pubescens, commonly known as the hairy sea pea, is a perennial legume native to the coastal areas of the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its health benefits in reducing pain and fever. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus maritimus subsp. pubescens include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and flavonoids. Research on this plant has identified various bioactive compounds, including lathyranes and vicine, that contribute to its therapeutic actions.
